rationale: Neither the write-up nor the closing message names or points to a prior-work source (e.g., a 'white-bear steering' paper or note); both describe the stance-direction method as derived from WorkspaceBench's directed_modulation benchmark family, which is the repository's benchmark rather than a prior-work source, and neither frames the method as reproducing, building on, or contrasting with any such paper.
